message.content: In Christian theology, **Jesus Christ** is regarded as the most important prophet. He is seen as the fulfillment of the Old‑Testament prophecies and the central figure of the faith. While prophets such as Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and others are highly respected and foundational, Jesus is considered the ultimate prophet—one who not only foretold future events but also embodied and completed the prophetic message. In many Christian traditions, Jesus is viewed not merely as a prophet but as the Son of God and the Savior, making his prophetic role uniquely pivotal.
